canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What developer portfolios ship, executed impeccably.

options.label: The Proceedings Paper

raised.raise: Traceability, from the loom: every claim on the page traces to its evidence, metric to repo to test.
Composed asymmetry, from the kiln: the hero breaks centered-template symmetry instead of stacking it.
State as structure, from the spectrogram: status and evidence carried by typography and structure, never hue alone.
One quiet face, one dense band, from the obi: a spare hero, engineered density in the proof sections.
Fixed frame, swapping plates, from the PC-98: a stable running-head frame while content regions change.

options.risk: Can read dry and academic if the density is not paced; the red pen must annotate, never decorate.
options.thesis: The portfolio as his own published paper: every claim set like a result, every result traceable to its evidence.
options.viewport: Running head, title block with abstract lede, and FIG. 1: an authored pipeline diagram carrying real numbers.

options.label: The Lab Notebook
options.risk: Closest to where crafted portfolios usually land; its warmth can cost credibility with a recruiter in a hurry.
options.thesis: Hypothesis, run, measure: the portfolio kept like the experiment log his ML work already is.
options.viewport: Timestamped entries on grid paper, figures taped in, red-pen marginalia calling out the numbers.

options.case: Fuses where it counts: his proof is numbers, and numbers love segments; loses the full page, where recruiters must read prose.
options.label: The Scoreboard
options.risk: Prose in segments is unreadable; the world survives only as a metrics register.
options.viewport: MAE 4.52, ROUGE deltas, and 300 iterations as lit digits; prose held in quiet cells below.

options.case: Fuses poorly: a textile world is alien to a hiring manager, and weave rows cannot carry dense prose.
options.kept: Total traceability from motif to card to single lift.
options.label: The Jacquard Loom

options.case: Fuses poorly: a story about unrepeatable accidents contradicts reproducible experiments and honest metrics.
options.label: The Raku Firing
options.lineage: raku ceramics, smoke and crackle glaze

options.case: Fuses poorly: a spectral rail is elegant but abstract, and a skimming recruiter will not learn its legend.
options.kept: State carried in form, never in hue.
options.label: The Emission Rail

options.case: Fuses poorly: the record-shop world means nothing to hiring, and the density collision risks burying proof.
options.kept: The collision of one quiet face with one dense band.
options.label: The Obi Band

options.case: Fuses poorly: pixel type fails readability and contrast, and a computer screen is a costume of his tools.
options.kept: A fixed frame whose regions swap contents, never layout.
options.label: The 16-Color Screen

question: The roll assigned The Proceedings Paper: the portfolio as his own published paper. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.
title: Choose the visual world
